blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Terrafirma wrapped up its 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup campaign on a bright note with a 147-115 victory over Titan Ultra in a game pitting two eliminated teams on Saturday at Ynares Center here. Juami Tiongson fired 30 points while veteran Maverick Ahanmisi produced his first career triple-double with 18 points, 10 rebounds and a career-best 14 assists as the Dyip ended the conference with a 5-7 win-loss slate. The Dyip finished fifth in Group A, but will once again miss the playoffs for the sixth consecutive conference.
